100.name: Bulgaria
100.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Slipping on grease, we slam into a Bull (Bulgaria) built super strong! | BURGER T (Black Sea)
100.notes: Borders Black Sea on east (Burgas, Varna ports). Danube River forms northern border with Romania. Balkan Mountains (Stara Planina) and Rhodope Mountains. Rose oil producer (Rose Valley).

104.name: Myanmar
104.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Waking from bang, X finds getaway car is Empty: M.T (M - Myanmar)! | Golden Triangle
104.notes: Borders Bay of Bengal and Andaman Sea. Irrawaddy River is lifeblood. World's foremost source of jadeite jade and rubies; major supplier of heavy rare earths to China (Kachin state). Sittwe Port is key component of India's Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Transport Project. Part of 'Golden Triangle' opium zone with Thailand and Laos. Dawei deep seaport.

108.name: Burundi
108.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Giant cup of BRU coffee (B - Burundi, R - Rwanda, U - Uganda) in the Great Rift!
108.notes: Small landlocked Great Lakes country bordering Lake Tanganyika, Rwanda, and DRC. Coffee and tea exports, nickel reserves.

112.name: Belarus
112.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Next clue: swing high on a Bell (Belarus)!
112.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Belarus.

116.name: Cambodia
116.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: X sets up camp in jungle: X is Camping (Cambodia / Tonle Sap)!
116.notes: Traversed by Mekong River. Contains Tonlé Sap: largest freshwater lake in Southeast Asia, with a unique pulsing flood-flow reversal system. Ream Naval Base on Gulf of Thailand (Chinese upgrade). Angkor Wat temple complex.

120.name: Cameroon
120.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: When we check contest winner, we realise it's James Cameroon (Cameroon)!
120.notes: 'Africa in miniature' (diverse biomes from Sahel to rainforest). Mount Cameroon active volcano. Lake Nyos (limnic eruption 1986). Chad-Cameroon oil pipeline terminates at Kribi port.

124.name: Canada
124.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Hero approaches Queen for help: she asks "CAN (Canada) you help US?"
124.notes: 2nd largest country in world by total area. Longest coastline in world (~243,000 km). Massive Athabasca oil sands in Alberta (world's 3rd largest oil reserves). Athabasca Basin in Saskatchewan produces world's highest-grade uranium (Cigar Lake, McArthur River). #1 world producer of potash (fertilizer) and major nickel, gold, and timber exporter. Great Lakes shared with USA. Northwest Passage in Arctic.

132.name: Cabo Verde
132.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Cabo Verde.

136.name: Cayman Is.
136.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Cayman Is..

140.name: Central African Republic
140.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: James Cameroon is about to get in his CAR (Central African Republic)!
140.notes: Landlocked country rich in diamonds, gold, and uranium. Ubangi River forms southern border. Ongoing civil conflict involving rebel coalitions and Russian Wagner/Africa Corps presence.

144.name: Sri Lanka
144.notes: Tear-shaped island in Indian Ocean separated from India by Palk Strait, Gulf of Mannar, and Adam's Bridge (Ram Setu). Straddles busy East-West international shipping lane. Hambantota Port (99-year lease to China) and Colombo Port (transshipment hub for Indian container traffic). High-grade Ceylon tea and vein graphite.

148.name: Chad
148.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Enquired why he is here, James Cameroon gets Sad (Chad / Lake Chad)!
148.notes: Landlocked country dominated by Sahara in north (Tibesti Mountains) and Sahel. Lake Chad has shrunk by >90% since 1960s due to climate change and irrigation, impacting 30 million people. Member of G5 Sahel.

152.name: Chile
152.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Olivia drags hero to market to buy Chilli (Chile / Atacama)! | Lithium Triangle
152.notes: Extraordinarily long and narrow country (>4,200 km north to south). World's #1 copper producer (>25% global supply; Escondida and El Teniente mines). Part of 'Lithium Triangle' (Salar de Atacama has highest concentration of lithium in world). Atacama Desert is driest non-polar desert on Earth, home to major astronomical observatories (ALMA). Strait of Magellan and Cape Horn at southern tip.

156.name: China
156.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Landing violently in the bunker, X gets his Chin hurt (China)!
156.notes: 2nd most populous country. Dominates global critical mineral supply chains: controls >60% of rare earth mining and >90% of refining; >70% of cobalt refining; >60% of lithium refining. Major rivers: Yangtze (Three Gorges Dam, world's largest power station) and Yellow River (Huang He). Tibetan Plateau ('Water Tower of Asia', headwaters of Indus, Brahmaputra/Yarlung Tsangpo, Mekong, Yangtze). Pearl River Delta and Yangtze Delta economic powerhouses. Nine-Dash Line claims across South China Sea.

158.name: Taiwan
158.notes: Island separated from mainland China by Taiwan Strait (~160 km wide). World's dominant contract manufacturer of advanced microchips / semiconductors (TSMC produces >90% of sub-7nm chips; 'Silicon Shield'). First Island Chain component. East coast borders Philippine Sea / Pacific Ocean. Mount Jade (Yushan).

170.name: Colombia
170.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Crossing into South America, we encounter the Ghost of Christopher Columbus (Colombia)!
170.notes: Only country in South America with coastlines on both the Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea. World's #1 emerald producer; famous for high-grade Arabica coffee. Cerrejón open-pit coal mine. Magdalena and Cauca river valleys between three Andean cordilleras. Borders Panama at Darién Gap.

174.name: Comoros
174.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Comoros.

178.name: Republic of the Congo
178.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Rangoli Section 2: King Kong (Republic of the Congo)!
178.notes: Separated from DRC across Congo River (Brazzaville & Kinshasa are closest capitals in world). Atlantic port of Pointe-Noire. Major oil and timber exporter. Crossed by Equator.

180.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
180.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Rangoli Section 3: King Kong in a doctor's suit with stethoscope (DR Congo)!
180.notes: Controls ~70% of world's cobalt production and massive reserves of coltan, copper, lithium, and tantalum. Congo River is 2nd largest river by discharge in world, crosses Equator twice, Grand Inga Dam potential. Eastern conflict in Kivu and Ituri (M23 rebel group, FDLR).

184.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Cook Is..

188.name: Costa Rica
188.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We gun car all the way down to the Coast (Costa Rica)!
188.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Costa Rica.

191.name: Croatia
191.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: The food van is owned by a Crow Boss (Croatia / Dalmatian coast)!
191.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Croatia.

192.name: Cuba
192.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Watching TV: C - Cuba!
192.notes: Largest island in Caribbean Sea. Controls entrance to Gulf of Mexico via Straits of Florida and Yucatán Channel. Major nickel and cobalt reserves (Moa). US naval base at Guantanamo Bay. Sugar cane and tobacco.

196.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Cyprus.

203.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Chasing the ostrich, we hear the eerie sound "Checkmate" (Czechia)!
203.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Czechia.

204.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: James Cameroon reveals he was victim of a Ben 10 (Benin) watch scam!
204.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Benin.

208.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Denmark.

214.name: Dominican Rep.
214.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: HD TV: D - Dominican Republic!
214.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Dominican Rep..

218.name: Ecuador
218.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Hero spots an Escape door (Ecuador / Equator) and dives straight into Pacific Ocean!
218.notes: Named after the Equator which passes through it. Controls Galápagos Islands in Pacific (biodiversity hotspot, Charles Darwin's evolution theory). Mount Chimborazo's summit is point on Earth's surface closest to the Sun (due to Earth's equatorial bulge). Major crude oil, banana, and shrimp exporter. Guayaquil is chief port.

222.name: El Salvador
222.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: The goat across table orders sweet Halwa (El Salvador)!
222.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for El Salvador.

226.name: Equatorial Guinea
226.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We don't win rangoli contest. When protested, the judge pulls out a GUN (Equatorial Guinea)!
226.notes: Only Spanish-speaking sovereign country in Africa. Capital Malabo is on Bioko Island in Gulf of Guinea, while continental territory is Rio Muni. Major offshore oil producer.

231.name: Ethiopia
231.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Floating rocks where we HOP (Horn of Africa / Ethiopia) to reach highest one! | Landlocked Horn of Africa (SEED)
231.notes: Most populous landlocked country in the world. Headwaters of Blue Nile (Lake Tana). Constructed the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD), sparking downstream disputes with Egypt and Sudan. Birthplace of Arabica coffee (Kaffa). Headquarters of African Union (Addis Ababa). Conflict: Tigray region.

232.name: Eritrea
232.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Navi character shows us the EDGE (ED - Eritrea & Djibouti), but pushes us down! | Red Sea (MEN SOW SEEDS), Horn of Africa
232.notes: Stretches along the southern Red Sea coast. Ports of Massawa and Assab. Seceded from Ethiopia in 1993, making Ethiopia landlocked. Dahlak Archipelago. Danakil Depression border.

233.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Land on LLEF (E - Estonia) Baltic shores!
233.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Estonia.

234.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Faeroe Is..

242.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Hero opens PoST: it is packed with Figs (Fiji) sent by Mr. Rabbit from Africa! Hero smiles!
242.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Fiji.

246.name: Finland
246.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Land on LLEF (F - Finland) right in front of a giant den!
246.notes: 'Land of a Thousand Lakes' (~188,000 lakes). 1,340-km land border with Russia. Joined NATO in 2023. Åland Islands autonomous demilitarized zone in Baltic. Saimaa Canal.

248.name: Åland
248.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Åland.

250.name: France
250.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: To add misery to sprained leg, a Branch (France) falls on the leg!
250.notes: Hexagon shape. Coasts on English Channel, Bay of Biscay (Atlantic), and Mediterranean Sea. Mont Blanc in Alps (highest peak in Western Europe). World leader in nuclear energy share (~70% electricity). Major agricultural producer in EU. Controls Corsica island and overseas territories (French Guiana, Réunion, New Caledonia).

258.name: Fr. Polynesia
258.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Fr. Polynesia.

260.name: Fr. South Antarctic Lands
260.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Fr. South Antarctic Lands.

262.name: Djibouti
262.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Navi character shows us the EDGE (ED - Eritrea & Djibouti), Bab-el-Mandeb chokepoint! | Horn of Africa (SEED)
262.notes: Guards the western gate of Bab-el-Mandeb Strait ('Gate of Tears') linking Red Sea to Gulf of Aden. Prime maritime logistics hub hosting military bases from USA (Camp Lemonnier), China, France, and Japan. Lake Assal is the lowest point in Africa (-155 m). Main sea outlet for landlocked Ethiopia.

266.name: Gabon
266.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Rangoli has 3 sections - Section 1: a gap / margin (Gabon)!
266.notes: Crossed by Equator. World's 2nd largest producer of manganese ore (Moanda mine). Heavily forested (~88% forest cover), major carbon sink. Oil exporter, former OPEC member.

268.name: Georgia
268.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: X reunites with his treacherous partner George (Georgia)! | BURGER T (Black Sea)
268.notes: Borders Black Sea (ports of Batumi and Poti). Greater Caucasus Mountains (Mount Shkhara). Breakaway Russian-occupied regions: Abkhazia and South Ossetia. Transit corridor for Caspian oil and gas pipelines bypassing Russia.

270.name: The Gambia
270.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We see a gal busy Gambling (The Gambia, enclaved in Senegal)!
270.notes: Smallest country in mainland Africa. Narrow strip surrounding Gambia River, entirely bordered by Senegal except for short Atlantic coast.

275.name: Palestine
275.notes: Comprises the West Bank (bordering Jordan and Dead Sea) and Gaza Strip (bordering Mediterranean Sea and Egypt/Rafah crossing).

276.name: Germany
276.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Dirty net causes a Germs (Germany) infection in the wound!
276.notes: Largest economy in Europe. Coasts on North Sea and Baltic Sea connected by Kiel Canal. Major rivers: Rhine, Danube (flows east to Black Sea), Elbe, Oder. Ruhr valley industrial heartland. Black Forest (source of Danube).

288.name: Ghana
288.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Ordered to go to a stage and Sing Ghana (Ghana / Lake Volta)!
288.notes: Top gold producer in Africa (former 'Gold Coast'). World's 2nd largest cocoa exporter. Lake Volta is world's largest manmade reservoir by surface area (created by Akosombo Dam).

296.name: Kiribati
296.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Kiribati.

300.name: Greece
300.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We don't trust crow boss and leave, but slip on Grease (Greece)!
300.notes: Southernmost tip of Balkan Peninsula. Aegean Sea, Ionian Sea, and Mediterranean Sea. Over 2,000 islands (Crete, Rhodes, Cyclades). Corinth Canal cuts through Isthmus of Corinth. Pindus mountain range. Mount Olympus.

304.name: Greenland
304.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Mass hero busts out of ice prison and lands to Touch Grass (Greenland)!
304.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Greenland.

308.name: Grenada
308.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Grenada.

316.name: Guam
316.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Guam.

320.name: Guatemala
320.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Across dining table sits a Goat (Guatemala)!
320.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Guatemala.

324.name: Guinea
324.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We take a GMail (Guinea) themed carpet and go on a ride!
324.notes: World's largest bauxite exporter (~25% global bauxite reserves). Simandou mountain range holds world's largest untapped high-grade iron ore reserve. Source of Niger, Senegal, and Gambia rivers in Fouta Djallon highlands.

328.name: Guyana
328.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Past zoo, we see a Guy (Guyana) surfing on ocean waves!
328.notes: Only English-speaking country in South America. Significant population of Indian descent (Indo-Guyanese). Center of massive deepwater offshore oil boom in Stabroek Block (ExxonMobil), making it world's fastest-growing economy. Disputed with Venezuela (Essequibo region covers 2/3 of its territory). Bauxite and gold mining.

332.name: Haiti
332.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: HD TV: H - Haiti!
332.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Haiti.

334.name: Heard I. and McDonald Is.
334.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Heard I. and McDonald Is..

336.name: Vatican
336.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Vatican.

340.name: Honduras
340.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Goat agrees to help and gives us keys to a Honda Car (Honduras)!
340.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Honduras.

344.name: Hong Kong
344.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Hong Kong.

348.name: Hungary
348.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We were so Hungry (Hungary) that the bun tasted heavenly!
348.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Hungary.

352.name: Iceland
352.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Enraged King imprisons hero in frozen Land of Ice (Iceland)!
352.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Iceland.

356.name: India
356.notes: Central position atop the Indian Ocean between Strait of Hormuz and Strait of Malacca. Himalayan mountain barrier in north; peninsular plateau with Western Ghats (UNESCO biodiversity hotspot) and Eastern Ghats. Crossed by Tropic of Cancer through 8 states (Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram). Major river basins: Ganga, Brahmaputra, Indus, Godavari, Krishna, Cauvery. Island territories: Andaman & Nicobar (Ten Degree Channel, Great Channel near Malacca) and Lakshadweep (Nine Degree & Eight Degree Channels).

360.name: Indonesia
360.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Disgusted by silly chips, X snaps "I am Done" (Indonesia / Sunda Strait)!
360.notes: World's largest archipelagic state (>17,000 islands; major islands: Sumatra, Java, Kalimantan/Borneo, Sulawesi, Papua). New capital Nusantara under construction in East Kalimantan. Holds world's largest nickel reserves and mine production (essential for EV batteries); banned raw nickel ore exports to force domestic smelting. #1 palm oil producer, major coal exporter. Key maritime chokepoints: Malacca Strait, Sunda Strait, Lombok Strait, Makassar Strait. Pacific Ring of Fire volcanoes (Krakatoa, Merapi).

364.name: Iran
364.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Terrified of Rocky Bhai, X Ran (Iran) for his life! | Strait of Hormuz, Caspian TARIK
364.notes: Dominates northern shore of Strait of Hormuz (chokepoint handling ~20% of world's petroleum). Borders Persian Gulf, Gulf of Oman, and Caspian Sea. Zagros and Elburz mountain ranges (Mount Damavand, highest volcano in Asia). Chabahar Port (developed with India to access Afghanistan & Central Asia). South Pars gas field.

368.name: Iraq
368.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: But instead of his friend, Rocky Bhai (Iraq) of KGF emerges from shadows! | Persian Gulf
368.notes: Heart of ancient Mesopotamia ('cradle of civilization'). Tigris and Euphrates rivers converge into Shatt al-Arab waterway before reaching Persian Gulf (narrow coastline with Basra port and Al-Faw Grand Port). Huge oil reserves (Rumaila, Kirkuk). OPEC founding member.

372.name: Ireland
372.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: In royal court, hero draws the King's Ire (Ireland)!
372.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Ireland.

376.name: Israel
376.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Fleeing with codes, X frantically asks: "Is a rail?" (Israel)! | LIST (Med) | MEN SOW SEEDS (Aqaba)
376.notes: Mediterranean coast to north-west; southern outlet to Red Sea via Gulf of Aqaba (Port of Eilat). Jordan River flows south into Dead Sea (lowest land elevation on Earth, -430 m). Sea of Galilee (Lake Tiberias). Negev Desert. Major offshore gas fields: Tamar and Leviathan.

380.name: Italy
380.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We go to an Idly shop (Italy / boot shape) to have a proper meal!
380.notes: Boot-shaped peninsula in Mediterranean Sea. Apennine Mountains run down spine; Alps to north. Po River valley is agricultural & industrial core. Active volcanoes: Mount Vesuvius, Mount Etna (Sicily), Stromboli ('Lighthouse of the Mediterranean'). Encloses San Marino and Vatican City.

384.name: Côte d'Ivoire
384.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Forced to sing ghana by an Elephant (Ivory Coast / Côte d'Ivoire)!
384.notes: World's #1 producer and exporter of cocoa beans (~45% of global market). Major cashew producer. Abidjan is major West African seaport and financial center.

388.name: Jamaica
388.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Watching TV: J - Jamaica!
388.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Jamaica.

392.name: Japan
392.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: From Russia, X and George Jump (Japan) into the secret underground Core!
392.notes: Stratovolcanic archipelago along Pacific Ring of Fire. 4 main islands: Hokkaido (north), Honshu (largest, Tokyo/Osaka), Shikoku, and Kyushu (south), plus Ryukyu/Okinawa islands. Mount Fuji. Bordered by Sea of Japan, Pacific Ocean, Sea of Okhotsk, and East China Sea. Kuril Islands dispute with Russia (Northern Territories); Senkaku Islands dispute with China. Global leader in autos, robotics, and semiconductor equipment.

398.name: Kazakhstan
398.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Distracting monkey with TUK KiT (K - Kazakhstan) videos! | Caspian TARIK
398.notes: World's largest landlocked country. Leading producer of uranium in the world (~43% global mined supply; Kazatomprom). Massive oil and gas reserves around Caspian Sea (Tengiz, Kashagan, Karachaganak fields; CPC pipeline). Baikonur Cosmodrome (leased by Russia). Altai and Tian Shan mountains on east. Shrinking Aral Sea on southwest.

400.name: Jordan
400.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Told yes, but train turns out to be a fake Cardboard train (Jordan / Gulf of Aqaba)!
400.notes: Nearly landlocked except for a 26-km coastline on Gulf of Aqaba (Red Sea). Borders Dead Sea and Jordan River on west. Vast eastern desert plateau. Ancient rock-cut city of Petra. Major potash and phosphate producer from Dead Sea.

404.name: Kenya
404.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Old man says "Somal" (go milk), but instead of a cow there is a giant ChicKEN (Kenya)!
404.notes: Crossed by Equator and Great Rift Valley. Mombasa port is gateway to East Africa (Northern Corridor to Uganda, Rwanda, South Sudan). World leader in black tea export, horticulture, cut flowers, and geothermal energy (Olkaria). Mount Kenya (2nd highest peak in Africa). Lake Victoria coast.

408.name: North Korea
408.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Jumping into the Core (Korea) bunker!
408.notes: Northern half of Korean Peninsula. Yalu and Tumen rivers border China and Russia. Mount Paektu sacred active volcano. Nuclear-armed state with missile testing in Sea of Japan.

410.name: South Korea
410.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Jumping into the Core (Korea) bunker!
410.notes: Southern half of Korean Peninsula. Separated from North Korea by 38th Parallel Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). Bordered by Yellow Sea and Sea of Japan (East Sea). Global powerhouse in memory semiconductors (Samsung, SK Hynix), display panels, electric vehicle batteries, shipbuilding (Ulsan), and automobiles. Jeju Island.

414.name: Kuwait
414.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: X parks and Waits (Kuwait) anxiously in the rain for his accomplice! | Persian Gulf
414.notes: Northwestern corner of Persian Gulf. Burgan oil field is 2nd largest conventional sandstone reservoir in the world. Borders Iraq and Saudi Arabia. Strategic Bubiyan Island.

417.name: Kyrgyzstan
417.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Distracting monkey with TUK KiT (K - Kyrgyzstan / Tian Shan) videos!
417.notes: Highly mountainous landlocked country dominated by Tian Shan mountain range ('Switzerland of Central Asia'). Issyk-Kul is world's 2nd largest alpine lake after Lake Titicaca (saline, never freezes). Kumtor gold mine. Fergana Valley enclaves.

418.name: Laos
418.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Stranded in deep jungle without car, X is completely Lost (Laos / landlocked)! | Golden Triangle
418.notes: Only landlocked country in Southeast Asia. Traversed by Mekong River. Aims to be the 'Battery of Southeast Asia' through extensive Mekong hydropower dam construction, raising downstream environmental concerns. Boten-Vientiane high-speed railway connects to China.

422.name: Lebanon
422.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Villain X orders hot Naan (Lebanon) with his feast! | LIST (Med)
422.notes: Small mountainous Mediterranean coastal state. Mount Lebanon and Anti-Lebanon ranges; fertile Beqaa Valley between them. Litani River (only major river entirely within Lebanon). Borders Israel (Blue Line boundary) and Syria. Cedars of Lebanon.

426.name: Lesotho
426.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Sailing south into South Africa: enclaves SL (L - Lesotho inside South Africa).
426.notes: Enclaved completely within South Africa. Drakensberg / Maloti Mountains; entire country sits above 1,000 m ('Kingdom in the Sky'). Lesotho Highlands Water Project supplies water to South Africa's Gauteng industrial hub.

428.name: Latvia
428.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Land on LLEF (L - Latvia) Baltic shores!
428.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Latvia.

430.name: Liberia
430.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Mass hero fights and Liberates (Liberia) James Cameroon!
430.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Liberia.

434.name: Libya
434.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Mr. Rabbit's hint "MALE" (L - Libya). | Mediterranean Littoral
434.notes: Largest proven crude oil reserves in Africa (Sirte Basin). Bordered by Mediterranean Sea (Gulf of Sirte). Great Man-Made River fossil water aquifer system. Post-Gaddafi division between Tripoli (west) and Tobruk/Benghazi (east).

438.name: Liechtenstein
438.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Liechtenstein.

440.name: Lithuania
440.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Swing on bell and land on LLEF (L - Lithuania) in front of a den!
440.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Lithuania.

442.name: Luxembourg
442.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We get Lux soap (Luxembourg) from a nearby shop to relieve the wound!
442.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Luxembourg.

446.name: Macao
446.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Macao.

450.name: Madagascar
450.notes: 4th largest island in the world. Separated from Africa by Mozambique Channel. Global leader in natural vanilla (~80% supply), nickel-cobalt (Ambatovy mine), and ilmenite. Extreme biodiversity endemism (>90% species found nowhere else, including lemurs). Canal des Pangalanes.

454.name: Malawi
454.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: After dancing with Victoria, we go to a Mall (Malawi)!
454.notes: Narrow landlocked country dominated by Lake Malawi (Lake Nyasa, 3rd largest lake in Africa, renowned for endemic cichlid fish). Major tobacco, tea, and sugar exporter.

458.name: Malaysia
458.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Singam shaped Lays (Malaysia) snack bag! | Malacca Strait
458.notes: Divided into Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia (Sabah & Sarawak on Borneo island), separated by South China Sea. Borders Strait of Malacca (Port of Tanjung Pelepas, Port Klang). World's 2nd largest palm oil producer after Indonesia; major semiconductor assembly and testing (ATP) hub in Penang.

462.name: Maldives
462.notes: Archipelago of 26 natural atolls (1,192 coral islands) in central Indian Ocean. Lowest average elevation country on Earth (~1.5 m above sea level, highly threatened by climate change). Eight Degree Channel separates northern Maldives from India's Minicoy Island. Strategic location along Persian Gulf to Malacca shipping lanes.

466.name: Mali
466.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Flying across the Sahara on a GMail (Mali) themed magic carpet!
466.notes: Landlocked Sahelian country. 3rd largest gold producer in Africa. Historic city of Timbuktu. Inland Niger Delta (wetland in semi-arid Sahel). Northern Tuareg / Azawad separatist and Islamist insurgency. AES member.

Isthmus of Tehuantepec (Interoceanic Corridor rail project).

504.notes: Controls ~70% of world's rock phosphate reserves (essential for NPK fertilizers). Borders Mediterranean Sea, Atlantic Ocean, and Strait of Gibraltar. Contains the High Atlas Mountains (Toubkal peak). Administers Western Sahara territory (disputed with Polisario Front).

508.name: Mozambique
508.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: At the mall, we spot 3 Zombies! (Zombie 3: Mozambique - Mozambique Channel).
508.notes: Coastline along Mozambique Channel (Indian Ocean). Giant offshore natural gas reserves in Rovuma Basin (Cabo Delgado province; hit by Islamist insurgency). Major graphite producer (Balama mine, world's largest). Zambezi river delta; Cahora Bassa dam.

512.name: Oman
512.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Cornered by Lord Yaman, X screeches and yells "Oh Man!" (Oman)! | Strait of Hormuz
512.notes: Controls the southern shore of the Strait of Hormuz via its northern Musandam Peninsula exclave. Strategic coastlines along Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea. Duqm deepwater port bypasses Strait of Hormuz (India granted logistics access). Al Hajar Mountains.

516.name: Namibia
516.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: In desert sands, we see a statue of a pen's Nib (Namibia) which cries diamonds! | Skeleton Coast, Orange River
516.notes: Namib Desert along Atlantic coast (oldest desert in world, Sossusvlei dunes). Major uranium producer (Rössing and Husab mines, #3 in world). Marine diamond dredging. Walvis Bay deepwater port. Caprivi Strip connects to Zambezi River.

520.name: Nauru

524.name: Nepal
524.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Exhausted, X takes a Nap (Nepal) under a giant street bulb!
524.notes: Landlocked Himalayan country between India and China. Contains 8 of the world's 14 peaks above 8,000 meters, including Mount Everest (Sagarmatha, 8,848.86 m) and Kanchenjunga border. Headwaters of Ganges tributaries: Kosi ('Sorrow of Bihar'), Gandak, Karnali (Ghaghara), Mahakali (Sharada; Kalapani border dispute).

528.name: Netherlands
528.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Asking a nearby fisherman for help, he ties a fishing Net (Netherlands) around the wound!
528.notes: About a third of land below sea level (protected by dikes, polders, and Delta Works). Port of Rotterdam is largest seaport in Europe. Rhine-Meuse-Scheldt delta. ASML semiconductor lithography hub (Veldhoven).

554.notes: Comprises North Island (volcanic, geothermal power) and South Island (Southern Alps, Mount Cook/Aoraki), separated by Cook Strait. World leader in dairy exports (~20-25% of global market, Fonterra cooperative) and sheep meat/wool. Alpine Fault earthquake zone.

562.notes: Landlocked Sahelian country. Major uranium producer in Africa (Arlit and Imouraren mines, key supplier to French nuclear reactors). Member of Alliance of Sahel States (AES) following 2023 military coup. Niger River flows through.

566.name: Nigeria
566.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We get ginger icecream in a Cafeteria (Nigeria / Niger Delta)!
566.notes: Most populous country in Africa (~220M). Leading crude oil exporter in Africa (Bonny Light crude from Niger Delta). Major gas reserves (NLNG Bonny Island, proposed Nigeria-Morocco Gas Pipeline). Lagos is commercial mega-city. Security challenges: Boko Haram in Lake Chad basin, banditry in Zamfara.

578.notes: Western part of Scandinavian Peninsula. Highly indented coastline with famous fjords. Major oil and natural gas producer from North Sea and Barents Sea (Sovereign Wealth Fund). Svalbard archipelago in Arctic (Svalbard Global Seed Vault).

586.notes: Indus River system (Indus, Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, Sutlej; governed by 1960 Indus Waters Treaty). Arabian Sea coastline featuring Gwadar Port (flagship hub of China-Pakistan Economic Corridor / CPEC). Karakoram Highway connects via Khunjerab Pass to China. K2 (2nd highest peak in world, 8,611 m) in Gilgit-Baltistan.

591.name: Panama
591.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: At coast, we cross a giant Pan shaped bridge (Panama Canal)!
591.notes: Is thmus connecting North and South America. Panama Canal (82 km long, opened 1914, expanded in 2016 for Neopanamax ships) connects Pacific Ocean with Caribbean Sea / Atlantic, saving ~13,000 km around Cape Horn. Darién Gap dense roadless jungle on Colombia border.

598.name: Papua New Guinea
598.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: On honeymoon, hero receives a mysterious PoST (P - Papua New Guinea)!
598.notes: Occupies eastern half of New Guinea island. Separated from Australia by Torres Strait. Highly rich in copper, gold (Porgera, Lihir mines), LNG, and nickel. Bougainville autonomous region voted for independence.

600.name: Paraguay
600.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Offended by wink, Olivia beats hero with Paragon slippers (Paraguay)!
600.notes: Landlocked country divided by Paraguay River into fertile Oriental region and semi-arid Gran Chaco. Itaipu Dam (shared with Brazil) and Yacyretá Dam (shared with Argentina) make it one of world's top net exporters of renewable hydroelectricity. Major soy and beef exporter.

604.name: Peru
604.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Olivia drags hero to buy Chilli and Pepper (Peru / Andes)!
604.notes: World's 2nd largest copper producer and 3rd largest silver producer. Andes mountain range runs north-south (Huascarán peak). Headwaters of Amazon River (Marañón and Ucayali confluence). Lake Titicaca on Bolivia border. Humboldt (Peru) Current creates hyper-rich marine fisheries (anchoveta) and dry coastal desert.

608.name: Philippines
608.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: X enters contest, changes his identity to Philip (Philippines), and wins!
608.notes: Archipelago of >7,000 islands grouped into Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao. Flanked by South China Sea (West Philippine Sea) and Philippine Sea (Pacific Ocean). Luzon Strait separates from Taiwan. Major nickel ore exporter to China. Flashpoints: Second Thomas Shoal (BRP Sierra Madre) and Scarborough Shoal. Pacific Ring of Fire (Mayon volcano, Mount Pinatubo).

612.name: Pitcairn Is.
612.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Pitcairn Is..

616.name: Poland
616.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Next trail: jump through the land of Poles (Poland)!
616.notes: Baltic Sea coastline (Gdańsk port). Vistula and Oder rivers. Suwałki Gap: narrow 65-km land corridor between Poland and Lithuania, flanked by Russian Kaliningrad exclave and Belarus (critical NATO choke point).

620.name: Portugal
620.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Escaping the saw in a boat across the Atlantic, the boat lands on a Port (Portugal)!
620.notes: Western part of Iberian Peninsula facing Atlantic Ocean. World's #1 cork producer (>50% global harvest from cork oak forests in Alentejo). Cabo da Roca is the westernmost point of continental Europe. Azores and Madeira autonomous Atlantic archipelagos. Douro River port wine.

624.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Guinea-Bissau.

634.name: Qatar
634.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Rocket blast backfires and hot Tar (Qatar) splashes on X's face! | Persian Gulf
634.notes: Peninsula protruding into the Persian Gulf. Shares the world's largest natural gas field, the North Dome / South Pars field, with Iran. One of the world's top LNG exporters. Ras Laffan industrial port. Only land border with Saudi Arabia.

642.name: Romania
642.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Strong bull glares and asks "Why are you Roaming?" (Romania)! | BURGER T (Black Sea)
642.notes: Borders Black Sea (Constanța port, largest Black Sea port). Danube River empties via Danube Delta (UNESCO biosphere reserve). Carpathian Mountains arc through center. Transylvania plateau.

643.name: Russia
643.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: X and George step on gas and Rush to Russia (Russia)! | Black Sea & Caspian Sea
643.notes: Largest country in world by area (~17.1M km²), spanning 11 time zones across Europe and Asia. Ural Mountains mark Europe-Asia boundary. Volga River is longest in Europe (empties into Caspian Sea). Lake Baikal is deepest and oldest freshwater lake on Earth. Massive oil, natural gas, nickel (Norilsk), palladium, and timber reserves. Exclave of Kaliningrad on Baltic Sea.

646.name: Rwanda
646.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Giant cup of BRU coffee (B - Burundi, R - Rwanda, U - Uganda) in the Great Rift!
646.notes: 'Land of a Thousand Hills'. Highly dense landlocked nation in Great Lakes region. Lake Kivu (contains dissolved methane). Major coltan and tantalum processor. Virunga volcanic mountains.

682.name: Saudi Arabia
682.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Abandoning cardboard train, X is handed an Audi car (Saudi Arabia)! | Red Sea & Persian Gulf
682.notes: Dominates Arabian Peninsula. Bordered by Red Sea on west and Persian Gulf on east. Holds world's 2nd largest proven oil reserves (Ghawar field, world's largest conventional onshore oil field). Rub' al Khali ('Empty Quarter') sand desert. Holy cities of Mecca and Medina. NEOM futuristic megacity on Gulf of Aqaba. OPEC de facto leader.

686.name: Senegal
686.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Left all alone, we go and see a Gal (Senegal) busy gambling!
686.notes: Cap-Vert Peninsula is the westernmost point of mainland Africa. Dakar is a major Atlantic port. Encloses The Gambia on three sides. Major peanut/groundnut producer; new offshore oil & gas producer (Sangomar, Greater Tortue Ahmeyim).

702.name: Singapore
702.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: X receives Singam (Singapore) shaped packets of Lays chips! | Malacca Strait
702.notes: Island city-state at southern tip of Malay Peninsula. Sits directly atop the Strait of Malacca and Singapore Strait (world's busiest maritime transit route handling ~25-30% of global sea trade). World's 2nd busiest container port (Tuas Mega Port) and leading global financial/oil-trading hub.

704.notes: S-shaped country along South China Sea coastline (>3,200 km). Red River Delta in north (Hanoi, Haiphong) and Mekong River Delta in south (Ho Chi Minh City). Disputed Paracel and Spratly island chains. Major global manufacturing hub (smartphones, electronics, footwear, EV supply chains). World's #2 coffee producer (robusta).

705.name: Slovenia
705.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Catching up with the Slow moving van (Slovenia)!
705.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Slovenia.

706.name: Somalia
706.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We fall from the edge and are saved by an old man who says "Somal" (go milk)! | Horn of Africa (SEED)
706.notes: Longest coastline on mainland Africa (~3,300 km), along Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean. Geopolitical flashpoint: Gulf of Aden piracy, Al-Shabaab insurgency. De-facto autonomous Somaliland in the north (Berbera port deal with Ethiopia) and Puntland. Cape Guardafui tip.

710.name: South Africa
710.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Taking a sand boat, we sail south again to South Africa!
710.notes: World leader in Platinum Group Metals (PGMs - >70% of world supply from Bushveld Igneous Complex), chromium, manganese, gold (Witwatersrand basin), and diamonds (Kimberley). Cape of Good Hope & Cape Agulhas (southernmost point of Africa, boundary between Atlantic & Indian Oceans). BRICS member.

716.name: Zimbabwe
716.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: At the mall, we spot 3 Zombies! (Zombie 2: Zimbabwe - Kariba Dam).
716.notes: Landlocked between Zambezi and Limpopo rivers. World's 3rd largest platinum reserves (Great Dyke mineral complex). Massive lithium deposits (Bikita mine; banned raw lithium exports to promote domestic refining). Victoria Falls.

724.name: Spain
724.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Jumping out of boat at port, hero Sprains his leg (Spain / Iberian peninsula)!
724.notes: Dominates Iberian Peninsula. World's largest olive oil producer (~40-50% global production, Andalusia). Controls Ceuta and Melilla enclaves in North Africa bordering Morocco. Separated from France by Pyrenees mountains. Catalan and Basque autonomy movements. Controls Balearic and Canary Islands.

728.name: South Sudan
728.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Escaping shooting sounds, we take a ship on the road and "sail south" (South Sudan).
728.notes: Youngest internationally recognized country in the world (gained independence in 2011 from Sudan). Completely landlocked. Vast oilfields (Melut and Muglad basins) piped north to Port Sudan. Contains the Sudd, one of the world's largest tropical freshwater wetlands.

729.name: Sudan
729.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: At Egypt, we hear SHOOTing (Sudan) sounds! We escape on a ship on the road and sail south. | Red Sea (MEN SOW SEEDS)
729.notes: Confluence of Blue Nile (from Lake Tana, Ethiopia) and White Nile (from Lake Victoria) at Khartoum. Red Sea coastline with Port Sudan. Conflict epicenter: Darfur region, Kordofan, and ongoing SAF vs RSF conflict. Gum arabic world leader (~70% supply).

732.name: Western Sahara
732.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Magic carpet crash-lands on a Saw with spikes (Western Sahara)!
732.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Western Sahara.

740.name: Suriname
740.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: The guy is Surfing (Suriname) along Guiana coast!
740.notes: Smallest sovereign country in South America. Former Dutch colony (Dutch-speaking). Significant Indian origin population (Indo-Surinamese). Heavily forested (>90% forest cover, carbon negative). Bauxite and gold producer; recent offshore oil discoveries.

748.name: Eswatini
748.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Sailing south into South Africa: enclaves SL (S - Swaziland / Eswatini).
748.notes: Formerly Swaziland. Small landlocked kingdom bordering South Africa and Mozambique. Sugar cane and forestry.

752.name: Sweden
752.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Slide and exit the Den (Sweden)!
752.notes: Scandinavian Peninsula bordering Gulf of Bothnia and Baltic Sea. Major high-grade iron ore reserves in Kiruna (LKAB mine). Joined NATO in 2024. Gotland island in Baltic.

756.name: Switzerland
756.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Exhausted from our injuries, we eat Sweets (Switzerland / Alps)!
756.notes: Landlocked alpine federal republic. Renowned for historic armed neutrality (joined UN in 2002). Alps and Jura mountains; Matterhorn peak. Source of Rhine and Rhône rivers. Geneva hosts numerous UN and international agencies (WTO, WHO, ICRC, CERN).

760.name: Syria
760.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Villain X dines on Cereal (Syria) with his biryani! | LIST (Med)
760.notes: Crossed by Euphrates River (Tabqa Dam/Lake Assad). Mediterranean coastline (Tartus naval base, Latakia). Golan Heights occupied by Israel since 1967 Six-Day War. Ancient cities of Damascus, Aleppo, Palmyra. Civil war flashpoints: Idlib, Rojava (Kurdish northeast).

762.name: Tajikistan
762.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Distracting monkey with TUK KiT (T - Tajikistan / Pamir Knot) videos!
762.notes: Dominated by Pamir Mountains ('Roof of the World', Ismoil Somoni Peak 7,495 m). Rogun Dam on Vakhsh River (world's tallest dam under construction, 335 m). Shares Wakhan Corridor border with Afghanistan. Amu Darya headwaters.

764.name: Thailand
764.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Car is M.T (T - Thailand)! George has betrayed him and stolen the car! | Golden Triangle
764.notes: Gulf of Thailand to east, Andaman Sea to west. Chao Phraya river basin. World leader in natural rubber and rice exports; 'Detroit of Southeast Asia' for automotive assembly. Kra Isthmus: proposed Kra Canal (or Landbridge) to connect Andaman Sea with Gulf of Thailand, bypassing Malacca Strait.

768.name: Togo
768.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Made a prisoner and ordered to GO TO (Togo) a stage!
768.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Togo.

776.name: Tonga
776.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Tonga.

780.name: Trinidad and Tobago
780.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Trinidad and Tobago.

784.name: United Arab Emirates
784.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: X hits vehicle's turbo Ignite button (UAE / Emirates) to escape! | Persian Gulf
784.notes: Federation of 7 emirates (Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah). Coastline along Persian Gulf; Fujairah has coast on Gulf of Oman (bypassing Strait of Hormuz for oil exports). Barakah nuclear power plant. Major global aviation, financial, and logistics hub.

788.name: Tunisia
788.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Mr. Rabbit plays a TUNE (Tunisia)! | Mediterranean Littoral
788.notes: Northernmost country in Africa (Cape Angela). Major producer and exporter of olive oil and dates. Birthplace of the Arab Spring (2010 Jasmine Revolution). Ancient Carthage ruins near Tunis.

792.name: Türkiye
792.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Scene cuts to Villain X hiding in Maze! He orders Turkey biriyani (Türkiye)! | LIST (Med) | BURGER T (Black Sea)
792.notes: Straddles Europe and Asia (Anatolian peninsula + East Thrace). Controls the Turkish Straits (Bosporus & Dardanelles via Sea of Marmara), regulated by 1936 Montreux Convention. Headwaters of Tigris and Euphrates rivers (GAP dam project). Borders Black Sea, Aegean Sea, and Mediterranean Sea. Earthquake-prone (North Anatolian Fault).

795.name: Turkmenistan
795.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: To distract monkey, X plays viral TUK KiT videos (T - Turkmenistan)! | Caspian TARIK
795.notes: Dominated by Karakum Desert (~80% area). Holds world's 4th largest natural gas reserves (Galkynysh gas field). Darvaza gas crater ('Door to Hell'). TAPI pipeline project (Turkmenistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan-India). Caspian Sea coastline with Turkmenbashi port.

796.name: Turks and Caicos Is.
796.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Turks and Caicos Is..

798.name: Tuvalu
798.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Hero receives a PoST (Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands, Tuvalu) with Figs (Fiji) sent by Mr. Rabbit! | 'T' in PoST
798.notes: Pacific island nation in Polynesia, formerly Ellice Islands. Comprises 3 reef islands and 6 true atolls; capital is Funafuti atoll. World's 4th smallest sovereign nation by land area (26 sq km). Extremely vulnerable to climate change and rising sea levels (highest elevation only ~4.6m). Signatory of landmark Falepili Union treaty with Australia providing climate migration pathways. Currency: Tuvaluan Dollar / Australian Dollar.

800.name: Uganda
800.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Giant cup of BRU coffee (B - Burundi, R - Rwanda, U - Uganda) beside Lake Victoria!
800.notes: Landlocked country on equator. Lake Victoria shoreline; source of White Nile at Jinja (Owen Falls Dam). Ruwenzori Mountains ('Mountains of the Moon'). Major robusta coffee and tea exporter. East African Crude Oil Pipeline (EACOP) to Tanga port, Tanzania.

804.name: Ukraine
804.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Bull's directions: cross the land where it Rains all the time (Ukraine / UK)! | BURGER T (Black Sea)
804.notes: 2nd largest country by area in Europe. 'Breadbasket of Europe' due to fertile Chernozem (black soil); major exporter of wheat, corn, sunflower oil. Black Sea and Sea of Azov coastlines; Crimean Peninsula occupied by Russia. Kerch Strait. Dnieper River bisects country. Donbas coal and heavy industrial basin. Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant.

807.name: Macedonia
807.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Crow boss drops key intel: villain X is hiding in a Maze (North Macedonia)!
807.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Macedonia.

818.name: Egypt
818.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Mr. Rabbit's hint "MALE" (E - Egypt). At Egypt, we hear SHOOTing sounds! | Red Sea (MEN SOW SEEDS), Suez Canal
818.notes: Suez Canal (opened 1869, 193 km, connects Port Said on Mediterranean to Port Tewfik on Red Sea; handles ~12% global trade). Sinai Peninsula forms land bridge between Africa and Asia. Nile River basin; Aswan High Dam and Lake Nasser. Bordered by Red Sea and Mediterranean.

826.name: United Kingdom
826.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Captain Hogan from Denmark sends us to the King (United Kingdom)!
826.notes: Comprises England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Controls strategic territory of Gibraltar at entrance to Mediterranean Sea. North Sea oil & gas (Brent benchmark). English Channel separates from mainland France. Dover Strait.

834.name: Tanzania
834.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: After BRU coffee, we meet Victoria, who Dances (Tan-zania) with us!
834.notes: Mount Kilimanjaro (highest peak in Africa, 5,895 m). Serengeti National Park and Ngorongoro Crater. Zanzibar archipelago (cloves, spice island). Dar es Salaam commercial port. Contains parts of 3 Great Lakes: Lake Victoria, Lake Tanganyika (2nd deepest in world), Lake Malawi.

840.name: United States of America
840.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Queen asks "CAN you help US (USA)?" | Great Lakes HOMES
840.notes: World's largest economy and #1 producer of crude oil and natural gas (shale revolution: Permian, Bakken basins). Mississippi-Missouri river system drains central agricultural heartland. St. Lawrence Seaway connects Great Lakes to Atlantic. Strategic territories: Alaska (separated from Russia by Bering Strait, 82 km wide) and Hawaii in central Pacific.

854.name: Burkina Faso
854.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Forced to sing by a Barking (Burkina Faso) elephant!
854.notes: Landlocked country in Sahel. Formerly Upper Volta (Volta river headwaters). Major gold producer. AES member following military coups.

858.name: Uruguay
858.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Slipper beating makes hero's designer shirt all Rugged (Uruguay / Rio de la Plata)!
858.notes: 2nd smallest country in South America. Sits along Río de la Plata estuary and Atlantic Ocean. High per-capita GDP; major exporter of beef, soy, and cellulose pulp. Powered almost entirely by renewable energy (wind, hydro, biomass).

860.name: Uzbekistan
860.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Distracting monkey with TUK KiT (U - Uzbekistan / Aral Sea) videos!
860.notes: One of only two doubly landlocked countries in the world (surrounded exclusively by landlocked countries; the other is Liechtenstein). Aral Sea catastrophe: diversion of Amu Darya and Syr Darya for cotton monoculture caused sea to shrink by >90%. Muruntau mine is one of world's largest open-pit gold mines. Silk Road cities: Samarkand, Bukhara, Khiva. Fergana Valley.

862.name: Venezuela
862.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Ghost directs us past a wild Zoo (Venezuela / Orinoco Basin)!
862.notes: Holds the world's largest proven crude oil reserves (~303 billion barrels, primarily heavy crude in the Orinoco Belt). Orinoco River basin; Guri Dam provides most electricity. Lake Maracaibo is largest lake in South America. Angel Falls (Salto Ángel) in Guiana Highlands is world's highest uninterrupted waterfall (979 m). Border dispute over Guyana's Essequibo region. OPEC founding member.

887.name: Yemen
887.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Speeding in Audi, Lord Yaman (Yemen) appears and chases him! | Bab-el-Mandeb, Red Sea
887.notes: Southern tip of Arabian Peninsula. Controls northern shore of Bab-el-Mandeb Strait, connecting Red Sea and Gulf of Aden (critical chokepoint targeted by Houthi rebel drone/missile strikes). Port of Aden and island of Socotra (UNESCO World Heritage site known for dragon blood trees).

894.name: Zambia
894.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: At the mall, we spot 3 Zombies! (Zombie 1: Zambia - Zambezi River, Victoria Falls).
894.notes: Landlocked country. Copperbelt province is Africa's 2nd largest copper producer and major cobalt source. Victoria Falls (Mosi-oa-Tunya) on Zambezi River border with Zimbabwe. Lake Kariba hydroelectric dam.

076.name: Brazil
076.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: We see a majestic Bright bridge with stars (Brazil flag / Amazon basin)!
076.notes: Largest country in South America by area and population. Amazon River basin and rainforest (largest rainforest on Earth, 'lungs of the planet', deforestation concerns). Cerrado tropical savanna (major agribusiness belt). World leader in coffee (#1), sugarcane ethanol (#1), soybeans (#1), beef, and orange juice. Carajás mine in Pará is world's largest iron ore deposit (Vale). Pre-salt deepwater offshore oil reserves (Santos Basin). Itaipu Dam on Paraná River border with Paraguay. BRICS founder.

072.name: Botswana
072.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: To escape 3 zombies, we take a boat in sands (Botswana / Kalahari Desert) and sail south again!
072.notes: World's top diamond producer by value (Debswana partnership; Jwaneng & Orapa mines). Completely landlocked; dominated by Kalahari Desert. Okavango Delta: world's largest inland delta, drains into desert sands without reaching sea.

070.name: Bosnia and Herz.
070.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Crow Boss (Bosnia) promises us food if we help serve!
070.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Bosnia and Herz..

068.name: Bolivia
068.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Spot Olivia (Bolivia) walking on sidewalk and give a mass wink! | Lithium Triangle
068.notes: Landlocked country (lost Pacific coastline to Chile in War of the Pacific 1879-84). Altiplano high plateau. Salar de Uyuni holds world's single largest lithium resource (~23M tonnes, part of Lithium Triangle). Lake Titicaca on Peru border (highest navigable lake in world, 3,812 m). Historic silver mountain of Cerro Rico at Potosí. Major natural gas exporter.

064.name: Bhutan
064.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Napping under a Bulb (Bhutan) hanging loose in Himalayas!
064.notes: Landlocked Himalayan kingdom. Carbon-negative country (constitutional requirement for >60% forest cover). Hydroelectricity exported to India (Chukha, Tala, Mangdechhu). Measures Gross National Happiness (GNH). Doklam plateau trijunction flashpoint between India, Bhutan, and China.

084.name: Belize
084.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Vexed, we stop at a Caribbean diner and order Bhel Puri (Belize)!
084.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Belize.

056.name: Belgium
056.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: In spite of soap, the infected leg Bulges (Belgium)!
056.notes: Hosts headquarters of European Union (EU) and NATO in Brussels. Port of Antwerp is 2nd largest in Europe and world's foremost diamond-trading hub. Divided between Dutch-speaking Flanders (north) and French-speaking Wallonia (south).

050.name: Bangladesh
050.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Hanging bulb falls and shatters with a loud BANG (Bangladesh / Bay of Bengal)!
050.notes: World's largest delta: Ganges-Brahmaputra-Meghna delta (Sundarbans mangrove forest, Royal Bengal tiger habitat). Extremely vulnerable to sea level rise and cyclones in Bay of Bengal. World's 2nd largest ready-made garment (RMG) exporter after China. Chattogram (Chittagong) port and Matarbari deep seaport.

048.name: Bahrain
048.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Face covered in tar, sky turns red as Beetroot rain (Bahrain) pours! | Persian Gulf
048.notes: Island nation in Persian Gulf connected to Saudi Arabia via King Fahd Causeway (25 km). First Arabian Gulf state where oil was discovered (1932). Hosts US Navy Fifth Fleet headquarters. Major aluminium smelter (Alba).

044.name: Bahamas
044.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: PUB with HD TV: B - Bahamas!
044.notes: Standard UPSC territorial outline for Bahamas.

031.name: Azerbaijan
031.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: X and George hop on vehicle, wave Bye Bye (Azerbaijan) to Rocky Bhai! | Caspian TARIK
031.notes: Borders Caspian Sea. Baku is historic center of oil & gas industry (Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan pipeline, Southern Gas Corridor). Exclave of Nakhchivan separated by Armenia. Regained full control of Nagorno-Karabakh in 2023.

036.name: Australia
036.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Officials pacify X with grand prize: a free Kangaroo ride to Australia! There he tries to sell codes to a rogue scientist. | B.Sc M.A PhD
036.notes: World's largest exporter of iron ore (Pilbara region) and mined lithium (#1 hard-rock spodumene producer). Major exporter of metallurgical & thermal coal, bauxite/aluminium, gold, LNG, and uranium (Olympic Dam). Great Barrier Reef (world's largest coral reef system). Murray-Darling river basin. Great Artesian Basin.

051.name: Armenia
051.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Running into Caucasus mountains, X finds Arms (Armenia) to defend himself!
051.notes: Landlocked country in South Caucasus between Black and Caspian Seas. Mount Ararat national symbol (now inside Turkey). Lake Sevan (major alpine freshwater lake). Border dispute and war over Nagorno-Karabakh with Azerbaijan; Syunik province / Zangezur corridor controversy.

032.name: Argentina
032.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Shirt torn, hero tries to Urgently go (Argentina / Pampas)! | Lithium Triangle
032.notes: 2nd largest country in South America. Pampas fertile lowlands: major producer of soy, wheat, and beef. Patagonia arid plateau in south. Andes Mountains form western border (Aconcagua, 6,961 m, highest peak outside Asia). Part of the 'Lithium Triangle' (Hombre Muerto and Olaroz salt flats). Vaca Muerta shale formation is world's 2nd largest shale gas reserve. Claims Falkland Islands (Islas Malvinas, UK).

024.name: Angola
024.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: In Southern Africa, we learn of a Rangoli (Angola) competition!
024.notes: One of Africa's top crude oil producers; quit OPEC in 2024 over quota dispute. Rich in alluvial diamonds. Lobito Corridor railway connects DRC & Zambia copper/cobalt belts to Atlantic. Exclave of Cabinda produces ~60% of its oil.

012.name: Algeria
012.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Mr. Rabbit's hint "MALE" (A - Algeria). | Mediterranean Littoral
012.notes: Largest country in Africa by land area. Major crude oil and natural gas supplier to Europe via underwater pipelines (Medgaz, Transmed). Over 80% covered by Sahara Desert. Ahaggar Mountains (Mount Tahat). OPEC member.

004.name: Afghanistan
004.mnemonic: 🎬 Spy Story: Code recovered! X hails a cab and tells driver to "Off the Ghana" (Afghanistan music)! | Golden Crescent
004.notes: Landlocked country centered around Hindu Kush mountain range. Strategic Wakhan Corridor connects to China's Xinjiang. Part of the 'Golden Crescent' opium-producing area with Iran and Pakistan. Massive untapped mineral wealth estimated at $1T+ including lithium, copper (Mes Aynak), rare earths, and iron ore (Hajigak). Amu Darya border river (Qosh Tepa canal project).

mnemonics.title: Black Sea Littoral Countries
mnemonics.notes: Kerch Strait connects Black Sea to Sea of Azov. Bosporus Strait connects Black Sea to Sea of Marmara. Danube, Dnieper, and Don rivers empty into it.

mnemonics.title: Mediterranean Coastline (West Asia / Levant)
mnemonics.notes: Remember: Jordan does NOT touch the Mediterranean (it accesses only Gulf of Aqaba/Red Sea).

mnemonics.title: Red Sea Littoral Countries
mnemonics.notes: Bordered to north by Suez Canal and Gulf of Aqaba (Israel/Jordan via Aqaba), to south by Bab-el-Mandeb Strait. (Mnemonic also known as DESSEY: Djibouti, Eritrea, Sudan, Saudi, Egypt, Yemen).

mnemonics.title: Persian Gulf Littoral Countries
mnemonics.notes: 8 nations border Persian Gulf. Strait of Hormuz connects Persian Gulf to Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea.

mnemonics.title: Caspian Sea Littoral Countries
mnemonics.notes: Largest inland body of water in world. Volga and Ural rivers empty into it. Rich in caviar (sturgeon) and offshore oil/gas.

mnemonics.title: North Africa / Mediterranean Front
mnemonics.notes: From West to East across North Africa: Morocco -> Algeria -> Libya -> Egypt. Plus Tunisia ('Play TUNE') wedged between Algeria and Libya.

mnemonics.title: Lithium Triangle (South America)
mnemonics.notes: Holds >55% of world's identified lithium brine resources in the high-altitude Andean salt flats.

mnemonics.title: Australian Major Cities (Clockwise from NE)
mnemonics.notes: Runs clockwise around the Australian coast starting from Brisbane down to Sydney, Canberra, Melbourne, Adelaide, west to Perth, and north to Darwin.

mnemonics.title: Horn of Africa Countries
mnemonics.notes: Strategic peninsula in northeast Africa protruding into Arabian Sea and Gulf of Aden.

mnemonics.title: Pacific Island Nations (Oceania)
mnemonics.mnemonic: PoST & Figs (Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands, Tuvalu, Fiji)
mnemonics.notes: From West to East across Melanesia and Polynesia: Papua New Guinea (P), Solomon Islands (S), Tuvalu (T), and Fiji (Figs). High-yield island geography in UPSC Prelims.
